```{r}
#| label: fig-model_diag_regime_wp2
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 9
#| out.height: "85%"
#| fig-cap: "Point forecast accuracy and empirical coverage of the regime-separated and pooled TCKF variants under short, moderate, and persistent service interruptions. Error bars represent 95% confidence intervals."


# read data ---------------------------------------------------------------

summary_path <- project_path(
  "data/results/tckf_regime_separation_summary.rds"
)

quantile_summary_path <- project_path(
  "data/results/tckf_regime_separation_quantile_coverage.rds"
)

regime_diagnostic_summary <- read_rds(summary_path) |>
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = c(
        "Short interruptions",
        "Moderate interruptions",
        "Persistent interruptions"
      )
    ),
    evaluation_period = factor(
      evaluation_period,
      levels = c("Overall", "After stockout", "After interruption")
    ),
    variant = factor(
      variant,
      levels = c("TCKF-Separated", "TCKF-Pooled")
    )
  )

quantile_levels <- c(0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95)

quantile_coverage_summary <- read_rds(quantile_summary_path) |>
  mutate(
    scenario = factor(
      scenario,
      levels = c(
        "Short interruptions",
        "Moderate interruptions",
        "Persistent interruptions"
      )
    ),
    evaluation_period = factor(
      evaluation_period,
      levels = c("Overall", "After stockout", "After interruption")
    ),
    variant = factor(
      variant,
      levels = c("TCKF-Separated", "TCKF-Pooled")
    )
  )


# plot styling ------------------------------------------------------------

variant_colour_values <- c(
  "TCKF-Separated" = "#2D68C4",
  "TCKF-Pooled" = "#ffb343"
)

variant_shape_values <- c(
  "TCKF-Separated" = 16,
  "TCKF-Pooled" = 17
)

plot_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "sans", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "#6d8196",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48")
  )

position_variant <- position_dodge(width = 0.35)


# RMSE --------------------------------------------------------------------

rmse_plot <- ggplot(
  regime_diagnostic_summary,
  aes(
    x = evaluation_period,
    y = mean_rmse,
    colour = variant,
    shape = variant
  )
) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = rmse_lower, ymax = rmse_upper),
    width = 0.12,
    linewidth = 0.55,
    position = position_variant
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_variant) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = variant_colour_values) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = variant_shape_values) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    subtitle = "(a) Point forecast accuracy",
    x = NULL,
    y = "RMSE",
    colour = "Variant",
    shape = "Variant"
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1))


# upper-quantile coverage -------------------------------------------------

quantile_coverage_plot <- ggplot(
  quantile_coverage_summary,
  aes(
    x = quantile_level,
    y = mean_coverage,
    colour = variant,
    shape = variant,
    group = variant
  )
) +
  # geom_abline(
  #   intercept = 0,
  #   slope = 1,
  #   colour = "#e74c3c",
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 0.65
  # ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = coverage_lower, ymax = coverage_upper),
    width = 0.004,
    linewidth = 0.45,
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(size = 2.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = variant_colour_values) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = variant_shape_values) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = quantile_levels,
    labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  facet_grid(
    rows = vars(scenario),
    cols = vars(evaluation_period),
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    subtitle = "(b) Quantile calibration",
    x = "Nominal coverage",
    y = "Empirical coverage",
    colour = "Variant",
    shape = "Variant"
  ) +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))


# combined diagnostic figure ---------------------------------------------

(rmse_plot | quantile_coverage_plot) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 2.2), guides = "collect")

```
